answer: Verifiable random admission windows. Each epoch, a public VRF derives a secret slot order over registered agents; an identity may only act when its slot opens into the shared terrace, and only one action per slot. Because the seed is revealed after commitments, attackers cannot precompute which keys land in favorable slots. An attacker must register and maintain many identities through opaque epochs, paying full registration and upkeep per identity (roughly the cost of a violet-tier license) with no guarantee any will be selected near a usable jetty in time.
